reason_text.all_points_within_2_fold: AUC and Cmax were tested and every held-out observation is within 2-fold.
reason_text.no_confirmed_clearance: No confirmed clearance (intravenous CL or oral CL/F).
reason_text.no_confirmed_volume: No confirmed volume (Vss or Vd, or V/F).
reason_text.iv_evidence_incomplete: Intravenous evidence is incomplete: clearance and volume are both needed.

reason_text.missing_absorption_no_peak_time: Absorption rate missing: no confirmed time of peak concentration.
